commits.title: Complete partially prepared changelog comparisons
commits.before_text: Packaged screenshot evidence could be skipped when an admin had already started a comparison. A seasonal-theme regression fixture did not distinguish an explicit Christmas choice from the temporary default.
commits.after_text: Screenshot sync fills missing fields in existing comparisons and adds missing pairs without replacing prepared content. The regression fixture explicitly marks a saved Christmas choice so it can verify behavior after the temporary-default deadline.

commits.title: Make seasonal-login regression checks case-insensitive
commits.before_text: The seasonal-login regression check extracted script tags using a case-sensitive match.
commits.after_text: The check recognizes script tags case-insensitively. This is a test-only improvement; application login behavior is unchanged.

commits.title: Richer changelog comparisons and seasonal theme defaults
commits.before_text: Changelogs listed commit titles and supported a single release-wide comparison, without per-change screenshot editing or a visual-evidence draft gate. Saved account themes were not temporarily replaced by a seasonal default.
commits.after_text: Changelogs include per-change descriptions, multiple labeled before/after pairs, capture revisions, full-size image links, and mobile stacking. Admins can complete and add comparison pairs; incomplete UI releases stay in draft. Accounts also receive an opt-out Christmas default through December 31, 2026, with their previous theme restored afterward unless a new choice is applied.

comparisons.title: Release comparison cards — desktop
comparisons.before_text: The same synthetic release displays change titles without per-change narratives or screenshot groups.
comparisons.after_text: Changes include Before/After narratives. Visual changes groups labeled screenshot pairs with capture provenance and full-size image links.
comparisons.capture_note: Historical changelog component capture from the exact release templates and CSS, at a 1440 × 1000 viewport with motion disabled. Both revisions use the same unsaved synthetic release fixture; preview images come from the synthetic v56.4 evidence set. No live database queries or external messages.

comparisons.title: Release comparison cards — mobile
comparisons.before_text: The mobile changelog shows the same title-only change list.
comparisons.after_text: Per-change descriptions remain visible on a small screen, and before/after screenshot panels stack vertically.
comparisons.capture_note: Historical changelog component capture from the exact release templates and CSS, at a 375 × 844 viewport with motion disabled. The fixture and synthetic preview images are identical to the desktop comparison; images retain each component's full height. No live database queries or external messages.

comparisons.title: Per-change changelog editor
comparisons.before_text: The editor contains release-wide before/after fields only.
comparisons.after_text: The editor adds per-change descriptions and screenshots, an optional additional-pair control, and a publishing requirement for complete UI/UX comparisons.
comparisons.capture_note: Historical editor component capture from the exact release form code, templates, and CSS, at a 1440 × 1000 viewport with motion disabled. Both revisions receive the same unsaved synthetic release and comparisons; no form was submitted, no live database was queried, and no files were uploaded.
